title: One gift, still paying
note: Fatima al-Fihri's ninth century endowment in Fez has outlived every dynasty that rose and fell around it.

research.quotes: heroes.html#fatima-al-fihri: 'In 859 CE Fatima founded al-Qarawiyyin, named for her family's home city, overseeing the project herself.' 'Dynasties rose and fell around it, roughly forty of them by some counts, and the lesson circles simply continued.' 'she built something so much larger than her biography that the building survived and the biography thinned.' 'wealth converted into a school that has outlived every dynasty around it.'
research.retell: A woman named Fatima al-Fihri gave her inheritance to found a mosque school in Fez in 859, and it has kept teaching students ever since, longer than any of the roughly forty dynasties that have risen and fallen around it.

lines.text: One gift never stopped paying out

lines.sub: a founder, Fatima al-Fihri, gives her wealth

lines.text: She endows a mosque with her inheritance
Dynasties rise, then fall, again and again
Beneath them, one line runs unbroken
lines.sub: the school itself just keeps teaching

lines.text: It is called waqf, an endowment forever
Her own story thinned. The school did not
lines.sub: recognized as the oldest still teaching

lines.text: Her gift still outlives every dynasty
She endowed it, and it never stopped
